about: Every tunable of the TTrades checklist. Edit 'value' only. 'rules' names the rules.md section, 'open_question' the numbered question in rules.md section 12 that the value answers or raises (null when the source states it). A description starting ANSWERED records a trader answer of 2026-11-12; PROPOSAL marks a default nobody has confirmed.

target_rr.description: ANSWERED (questions 15, 16). The exit: a fixed reward-to-risk multiple of the risk (entry to stop). With target_mode 'r_multiple', Verdict.targets[0] = entry +/- target_rr * risk. The trader said 'one to one or one to two'; 2.0 is the default, 1.0 the other value named.

target_mode.description: 'r_multiple' (default, the trader's answer): the only target is the target_rr price and the structural levels are information. 'structural' (the rule before the answer): the targets are the structural levels T1 / T2.

min_rr.description: Threshold of *_reward_at_least_2r: the structural first level (previous bias candle high / low on a continuation, its equilibrium on a reversal) sits at least this many multiples of risk away. Information only unless reward_check_role is 'quality'.

reward_check_role.description: Class of cont_reward_at_least_2r / rev_reward_at_least_2r. 'advisory' (default, from the trader's answer: the exit is the R multiple, so the structural distance no longer blocks). 'quality' restores the old rule: the structural first level must be min_rr away or the verdict stays watch, and the body stop may be used to reach it.

cisd_max_bars.description: A change in state of delivery is 'swift' when it confirms within this many bars of the extreme.

entry_mode_continuation.description: ANSWERED (question 14). 'either' (default): the trigger is whichever of the entry-timeframe CISD or a continuation order block confirms first. 'aggressive': only the entry CISD. 'conservative': only a continuation order block after it. When the bias Candle 2 expanded the CISD entry is not allowed, so 'either' and 'aggressive' are left with the order block.

entry_mode_reversal.description: ANSWERED (question 14). Same choice for the reversal path: 'either' (default), 'aggressive' (the bar that confirmed the reversal CISD) or 'conservative' (a continuation order block after it).

entry_either_pick.description: PROPOSAL. In 'either' mode, when a CISD trigger and one or more continuation order blocks all exist and none has been stopped: 'first' reports the one that confirmed first (it stays the trigger at later checks), 'latest' reports the most recent one (fresher entry price, tighter stop).

kill_zones.description: New York clock windows (start, end, both inclusive) that session_filter_ok reports on. Sources give 11:00, 11:30 and 12:00 for the New York AM end. Whether the result affects the decision is session_filter_role.

session_filter_role.description: ANSWERED (question 18). Class of session_filter_ok. 'advisory' (default, the trader's answer): computed and shown, never changes the decision. 'quality' restores the old rule: a trigger outside the kill zones keeps the verdict at watch.

kill_zone_applies_below_minutes.description: Kill zones apply only when the entry timeframe is shorter than this many minutes (60 = below 1h).

reversal_entry_tf_confirm_bias.description: Bias timeframes for which the reversal CISD may be read on the entry timeframe instead of the setup timeframe.

reversal_entry_tf_confirm_window.description: New York clock window in which that entry-timeframe confirmation is accepted.

sweep_reclaim_max_bars.description: Bars allowed between a level being taken and the close back inside for a Sweep. Listed in rules.md section 11 but no criterion in sections 6 or 7 uses a Sweep, so this value is currently not read by any check.

avg_range_bars.description: Closed bias candles averaged (high - low) to get the yardstick for wick size.

wick_yardstick.description: ANSWERED (question 2): keep 'avg_range' (the opposing run as a share of the avg_range_bars average bias range). 'body' is the alternative the trader described: the opposing run measured against that same candle's body so far, using wick_body_small_frac / wick_body_large_frac.

wick_small_frac.description: Yardstick 'avg_range': the forming candle's wick is 'small' when the opposing run is at most this share of the average range (and it formed early).

wick_large_frac.description: Yardstick 'avg_range': the forming candle's wick is 'large' when the opposing run is at least this share of the average range (or it formed late).

wick_body_small_frac.description: PROPOSAL, yardstick 'body' only: the wick is 'small' when the opposing run is at most this multiple of the candle's body so far (and it formed early).

wick_body_large_frac.description: PROPOSAL, yardstick 'body' only: the wick is 'large' when the opposing run is at least this multiple of the body so far (a wick as long as the body), or it formed late.

wick_time_frac_max.description: Non-daily bias: the wick is 'early' when its extreme is made within this share of the bias candle's duration.

daily_wick_deadline.description: Daily bias: the wick is 'early' when its extreme is made before this New York clock time on the candle's trading day.

respect_level_mode.description: 'auto' uses the wick midpoint when the previous bias candle is a Candle 2 closure with a large closed wick and the equilibrium otherwise; 'eq' or 'wick_mid' fixes the choice.

closed_wick_large_frac.description: A closed candle's wick is 'large' when it is at least this share of the candle's range.

eq_tolerance_frac.description: How far past the respect level a setup-timeframe close may go, as a share of the previous bias candle's range.

objective_open_role.description: ANSWERED (question 16). Class of cont_objective_open ('previous bias candle high / low not yet taken'). 'advisory' (default: the exit is the R multiple, so the continuation path stays alive after that level trades). 'gate' restores the old rule: the path ends once it is taken.

candle3_body_edge.description: Body edge of Candle 2 that a Candle 3 closure must close beyond: 'far' (max(open, close) bullish) or 'open'.

doji_in_series.description: Whether a close == open candle is folded into the run of opposite-close candles that defines a CISD level. It never starts a series.

setup_body_alignment_required.description: true: a setup Candle 2 closure whose body disagrees with the direction blocks entry-ready (quality). false: reported as advisory only.

fvg_min_size.description: Smallest fair value gap (top - bottom, in price units) that counts as a point of interest.

bias_poi_lookback_bars.description: How many bias-timeframe bars back a swing or gap may sit to count as the bias point of interest, by bias timeframe. 'default' serves bias timeframes not listed (custom stacks).

reversal_key_levels.description: ANSWERED (question 1). Which bias-timeframe levels count as a key level for a reversal: 'previous_candle' (its high / low), 'swing' (untaken swing highs / lows inside bias_poi_lookback_bars), 'fvg' (unfilled fair value gaps inside the same lookback). ["previous_candle"] with reversal_level_tolerance_frac 0 is the old 'has run the previous candle's high / low' test.

reversal_level_tolerance_frac.description: PROPOSAL for 'at or near a key level': the forming bias candle's extreme has reached a key level when it traded through it (a gap: into it) or came within this share of the avg_range_bars average bias range. 0 = the level must be traded through.

reversal_expansion_test.description: PROPOSAL for 'expansion out' (rev_expansion_into_level, a quality check). 'directional_run': the setup-timeframe candles into the extreme are a run of candles closing toward the level, at least reversal_expansion_min_bars long, that travelled at least reversal_expansion_min_travel_frac of the average setup-timeframe range. 'off': reaching the level is sufficient; the same measurement is shown as advisory.

reversal_expansion_min_bars.description: PROPOSAL. Minimum number of consecutive setup-timeframe candles closing toward the level in the run that ends at the extreme. TTrades often shows a one-candle series, hence 1.

reversal_expansion_min_travel_frac.description: PROPOSAL. Minimum distance from the first open of that run to the extreme, as a multiple of the average range of the last avg_range_bars closed setup-timeframe candles. 0 switches the distance test off.

protected_swing_break_on.description: 'wick': any trade through a protected swing breaks it. 'close': only a close beyond it.

body_stop_allowed.description: Whether the stop may move to the bodies of the trigger series to reach the minimum reward. Only acts when reward_check_role is 'quality'; with the default advisory reward check the stop always rests on the protected swing.

body_stop_min_body_frac.description: The body stop is allowed only when every candle of the trigger series has a body of at least this share of its range.

stop_buffer.description: Extra room beyond the stop swing, in price units.

entry_window_extra_candles.description: Setup-timeframe candles allowed for the trigger beyond the rule (Candle 3, plus Candle 4 after a strong Candle 3).

block_unstated_stacks.description: false: a stack TTrades never states still runs and is flagged by the advisory stack_pairing_stated. true: that criterion becomes a gate.

setup_cover_bias_bars.description: Setup-timeframe history requested, in bias candles. Must cover the three candles data_sufficient asks for.

entry_cover_bias_bars.description: Entry-timeframe history requested, in bias candles. Must cover the previous bias candle and the forming one.

max_frame_bars.description: Upper bound on the bars requested for one timeframe.

stated_stacks.description: Bias / setup / entry stacks TTrades states (rules.md 4.2 stack table).

stated_pairings.description: Higher : lower timeframe pairings TTrades states (rules.md 4.2 pairing table).
